records.label: Bamboo clump
records.evidence: Survey clump symbol; not an individual stem count
records.positionNote: Centroid of 33 decorative block instances; clump extends across the provisional boundary.

provenance.source: CONTOUR SEETHAMAUND (3).dwg, model-space block INSERT entities in original main-parcel coordinate range
provenance.legendMapping: Matched block types against adjacent text and block instances in the drawing legend. Original labels retained where identity unresolved.
provenance.excluded: Electric posts (WELL10 EP), drawing legend, copied layouts, and non-vegetation geometry excluded.
provenance.bamboo: 33 rtrg block insertions form one compact mapped clump; not 33 individual trees.
provenance.height: INSERT Z values are not used as tree heights or absolute ground elevations. Ground elevation comes from the selected model; all marker dimensions are symbolic.
provenance.inventoryLimit: Selected survey vegetation, not a complete or current plant census. Coffee, pepper, smaller plants and unmapped vegetation are not represented.
provenance.coconutComparison: 68 extracted coconut symbols versus approximately 90 palms in the owner-reported baseline. Earlier visual symbol counts also differ; reconciliation requires field inventory.
provenance.spatialLimit: Original drawing coordinates are preserved. CRS, datum and candidate boundary remain provisional. Near-edge ground heights use the nearest supported model cell.
